verdict.rationale: Warp is an HR/payroll platform with its own Warp Agent, so letting users plug external MCP servers into it is a fair question. The evidence only shows the opposite direction: Warp being used from external MCP clients such as Claude and ChatGPT. Nothing shows Warp itself connecting to user-supplied MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
